title: CSV Evidence Lab federation temporal coherence audit

evidence.finding: EvidenceLabRemoteSync fetches five mutable files sequentially and verifies each Git blob, but does not pin all files to one producer commit/tree.

blockers: No single producer commit/tree binds all required federation receipts
RUN_ID disagreement across heartbeat/latest/finalization; evidence_state RUN_ID is null
No quantitative/performance inference is admissible from this federation state
next_decisive_experiment: Pin one producer commit SHA/tree, fetch all required files at that immutable ref, require coherent RUN_ID semantics (or explicitly versioned asynchronous semantics), then adversarially mutate/advance pointers between reads and verify fail-closed behavior.

aion.finding: Durable causal memory must not treat the current CSV federation read as one as-of state because verified blobs belong to different run generations.

ascension.finding: Per-file Git-blob verification does not establish cross-file snapshot coherence; authority must fail closed until a single immutable producer revision binds the receipt set.

prometheus.finding: Prioritize an adversarial torn-read experiment and immutable-ref snapshot contract before mining CSV federation outputs for hypotheses.
